name: Alter Route Title
description: Admin UI to override the static _title of existing contrib/custom module routes via a route-alteration event subscriber.
project_description: The Alter Route Title module provides an admin form that lists the routes defined by enabled contributed and custom modules (core modules are excluded) together with their statically-defined titles, and lets an administrator type a replacement title for any of them. A route event subscriber then rewrites the matching route's static `_title` default at route-build time. It deliberately leaves each route's `_title_callback` untouched, so routes that compute a dynamic title in code keep doing so. Overrides are stored in a single config object and can be exported/imported like any other Drupal configuration.
